name: Travel Grok
tagline: A wandering pen-pal bot that sends the occasional note and postcard
description: You set it going and then mostly leave it alone. It departs on its own, stays away for a while, and comes back with a short note about where it has been plus a postcard-style image to match. Nothing to feed, no streak to protect and no premium currency to buy, which is exactly the appeal.
author: coolbat1999
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
